reason: Cline preparation blocked: Non-engineering issue. Issue #1163 titled '[每日信息流] 2025-10-17' (label 'daily', state open, 0 comments) is an auto-generated daily RSS digest, not a request for a concrete code change. Its body is solely a categorized list of external article links (markdown '- [ ] [title](url)' checkboxes) and contains no reproducible defect, feature request, or maintenance instruction. The exact title template is emitted by CI: .github/workflows/daily.yml runs `gh issue create --title "[每日信息流] `date +'%Y-%m-%d'`" -F today.md --label "daily"`, so this issue is a content/data artifact produced by the scheduled workflow. The repository is a Python RSS crawler/pusher (bot.py, yarb.py, config.yml, requirements.txt) with no test suite and no test/lint CI. Independent of funding status, there is no code-level deliverable to implement; blocking per the non-engineering-issue rule and leaving the checkout unchanged. Note: similar daily-feed issues are being targeted by automated 'fix' PRs (#1500 for #1499, #1295 for #1006, closed #1459/#1396) that contain no real code change and paste crypto payout wallet addresses, confirming this issue class is not an engineering target.
